description: The manufacturing assembly stage to which this AGV movement is associated (e.g., stamping, body shop, paint, trim, chassis, final assembly). Enables stage-level material flow analysis and supports multi-stage production traceability.

description: The date and time when this AGV movement record was first created in the MES or data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

reference: SMED Methodology - Shigeo Shingo; SAE International

description: Model Year (MY) of the vehicle being introduced on the production line after the changeover. Used for production planning, regulatory compliance, and homologation tracking.
reference: NHTSA - Vehicle Identification; SAP S/4HANA PP

description: Planned duration of the changeover in minutes as defined in the production schedule. Baseline for SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) improvement tracking.
Scheduled date and time when the changeover was planned to be completed. Used to calculate planned changeover duration and production window impact.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP - Production Planning; IATF 16949

description: Scheduled date and time when the changeover was planned to begin, as defined in the production schedule. Used for SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) baseline comparison.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP - Production Planning; IATF 16949

description: Number of vehicle units not produced due to the changeover downtime. Calculated as the difference between potential production capacity and actual output during the changeover window. Key metric for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) and capacity planning.

Indicates whether the post-changeover quality gate inspection was passed (True) before resuming full production. A False value indicates the line was held pending rework or re-inspection per IATF 16949 quality control requirements.
reference: IATF 16949 - Quality Gates; APQP; Apriso/Dassault MES

description: Standardized code indicating the business reason that triggered the changeover event (e.g., scheduled model mix, customer order sequence, engineering change, maintenance requirement). Used for root cause analysis and frequency reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP - Production Orders; IATF 16949

description: Free-text description providing additional context for the changeover reason, supplementing the reason code with operator or supervisor notes.

Reference to the SAP S/4HANA production order number associated with the post-changeover production run. Enables cost allocation and production confirmation reconciliation in SAP PP (Production Planning).

Number of vehicle units scrapped or rejected during the changeover transition period before the first good unit was produced. Contributes to quality loss calculation in OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness).
reference: IATF 16949 - Scrap Reporting; SAP S/4HANA QM

description: Takt time in seconds applicable to the production line at the time of changeover. Used to calculate production loss units and assess changeover impact on line throughput.
Body style classification of the vehicle to be produced after the changeover (e.g., sedan, SUV, truck). Used to categorize body style changeover events.
reference: SAE International J1100 - Vehicle Body Styles

description: Paint color code of the vehicle to be produced after the changeover. Relevant for color change changeover events in the paint shop.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES - Quality Control; SAP S/4HANA PP

description: Powertrain variant to be produced after the changeover. ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle).
reference: SAE International J1715; EPA Emissions Standards

description: Vehicle model code of the product to be produced on the line immediately after the changeover. Identifies the incoming model in a model mix change scenario.
reference: Siemens Teamcenter PLM - BOM Management; SAP S/4HANA PP

description: Indicates whether the changeover required a physical tooling swap or die change (True) or was a parameter/program-only changeover (False). Drives tooling logistics planning and SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) categorization.
reference: IATF 16949 - Tooling Management; SAP S/4HANA PM

description: Time in minutes required specifically for tooling installation, adjustment, and verification during the changeover. Subset of internal changeover elements used for tooling-specific SMED analysis.
Timestamp when the changeover record was last modified in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and incremental load processing for the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
reference: IATF 16949 - Record Control; ISO 9001 - Document Control

description: Difference in minutes between actual and planned changeover duration (actual_duration_minutes minus planned_duration_minutes). Positive value indicates overrun; negative indicates early completion. Key SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) performance indicator.

reference: IATF 16949 Section 9.1 – Monitoring, Measurement, Analysis and Evaluation

description: Reference to the maintenance, production, or quality team responsible for resolving the downtime event. Used for accountability tracking and response time analysis.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM – Work Center (Maintenance); IATF 16949 Section 7.1.2

description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where the downtime event occurred. Corresponds to the SAP Plant (Werk) organizational unit.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP – Plant (Werk); IATF 16949 Section 4.3

description: Reference to the specific machine, robot, AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle), or equipment asset that experienced the downtime. Maps to SAP PM Equipment master record.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM – Equipment Master; ISO 14224 – Equipment Taxonomy

description: Reference to the production line (e.g., stamping line, body shop line, paint line, final assembly line) affected by the downtime event. Enables line-level OEE and throughput impact analysis.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – Production Line; SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Line

description: Reference to the SAP PP Production Order (Fertigungsauftrag) that was active or impacted at the time of the downtime event. Used to quantify production order impact and schedule deviation.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Order; IATF 16949 Section 8.5

description: Reference to the employee (operator, technician, or supervisor) who initially reported or logged the downtime event in the MES or SAP system.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM – Notification Reported By; SuccessFactors – Employee Master

description: Reference to the specific work center or production cell where the downtime event was recorded. Maps to SAP PP Work Center (Arbeitsplatz) or MES work station definition. Critical for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) analysis at the work center level.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP – Work Center; Apriso MES – Work Center; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

description: The manufacturing process area impacted by the downtime event. Reflects the major shop segments in automotive assembly: stamping (press shop), body shop (BIW - Body in White), paint shop, final assembly, powertrain assembly, chassis, trim, or general assembly. Used for plant-level downtime distribution analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stamping|body_shop|paint|final_assembly|powertrain|chassis|trim|general_assembly — promote to reference product]
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – Process Area; IATF 16949 Section 8.5; SAP PP – Production Process

description: Standardized code from the SAP PM activity type catalog describing the corrective action taken to resolve the downtime event (e.g., part replacement, lubrication, calibration, software reset, tooling adjustment). Supports FMEA corrective action tracking and spare parts consumption analysis.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM – Activity Type Code; IATF 16949 Section 10.2; AIAG 8D

description: The timestamp when the downtime event record was first created in the source system (MES, SAP PM, or SCADA). Represents the audit creation time, distinct from start_timestamp which is the actual business event time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
reference: IATF 16949 Section 7.5 – Documented Information; SAP S/4HANA – Record Creation Timestamp

description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the maintenance_cost_local field (e.g., USD, EUR, MXN, CNY). Required for multi-plant, multi-currency cost consolidation in global automotive manufacturing operations.
reference: ISO 4217 – Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI – Currency Configuration

description: Primary classification of the downtime event type. 'mechanical_failure' covers equipment breakdowns; 'tooling_change' covers die/tool swap activities; 'material_shortage' covers JIT/JIS supply disruptions; 'quality_hold' covers production stops due to quality issues; 'scheduled_maintenance' covers planned PM activities; 'changeover' covers model or variant changeover activities. Drives OEE availability loss categorization.
reference: IATF 16949 Section 9.1 – OEE; SAP PM – Notification Type; ISO 22400-2 – KPI for Manufacturing

description: Indicates whether the downtime event was planned (scheduled maintenance, changeover, tooling change per production schedule) or unplanned (unexpected breakdown, quality hold, material shortage). Critical for separating planned vs. unplanned OEE availability losses.
reference: ISO 22400-2 – Planned vs. Unplanned Downtime; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

description: Total elapsed duration of the downtime event in minutes, calculated as the difference between end_timestamp and start_timestamp. Stored as a business field for direct use in OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) availability calculations and SCADA-integrated downtime reporting. Null if the event has not yet ended.
reference: ISO 22400-2 – Downtime Duration; IATF 16949 Section 9.1; SAP PM – Breakdown Duration

description: The exact date and time when the downtime event ended and production resumed, as recorded by the MES or SCADA system. Null if the event is still active. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – Downtime End; SCADA Event Log; ISO 22400-2

description: Indicates the management escalation level reached during the downtime event based on duration thresholds or safety/quality triggers. 'none' = resolved at operator level; 'supervisor' = shift supervisor notified; 'manager' = production manager engaged; 'plant_director' = plant director escalation triggered. Supports escalation SLA compliance reporting.
reference: IATF 16949 Section 5.3 – Organizational Roles; SAP PM – Notification Priority; Internal Escalation Matrix

description: The calendar date on which the downtime event started. Derived from start_timestamp for day-level partitioning, reporting, and trend analysis. Stored as a separate DATE field to support efficient date-range queries and daily OEE dashboard aggregations. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
reference: ISO 22400-2 – Downtime Reporting; SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Date

description: Free-text narrative description of the downtime event as entered by the operator, technician, or supervisor in the MES or SAP PM notification. Captures contextual details not covered by structured codes, such as observed symptoms, environmental conditions, or operator observations at the time of failure.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM – Notification Long Text; Apriso MES – Event Notes; IATF 16949 Section 10.2

description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the downtime event, typically generated by the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) or SAP PM (Plant Maintenance) module. Format: DT-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}. Used for cross-system referencing and shop floor communication.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – Downtime Event Reference; SAP PM Notification Number

description: Current lifecycle status of the downtime event record. 'open' indicates the event is active and unresolved; 'in_progress' indicates a repair or corrective action is underway; 'resolved' indicates the root cause has been addressed; 'closed' indicates the event is fully documented and closed; 'cancelled' indicates the event was logged in error.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM – Notification Status; Apriso MES – Downtime Status; IATF 16949 Section 10.2

description: Standardized code identifying the specific failure mode that caused the downtime event, aligned with the FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) failure mode library. Examples: electrical fault, hydraulic leak, sensor failure, conveyor jam. Enables FMEA-driven root cause trending and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) corrective action tracking.
reference: IATF 16949 Section 10.2 – FMEA; SAP PM – Damage Code; AIAG FMEA Reference Manual

description: SAP PM object part / location code identifying the specific component or sub-assembly on the equipment where the fault occurred (e.g., spindle, conveyor belt, welding gun tip, paint nozzle). Enables component-level failure frequency analysis and spare parts demand forecasting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM – Object Part Code; ISO 14224 – Equipment Taxonomy; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

description: Indicates whether the downtime event triggered a quality hold on WIP (Work in Progress) or finished vehicle inventory. True = quality hold was activated; False = no quality hold. Links to SAP QM quality notification and SPC (Statistical Process Control) out-of-control action plans.
reference: SAP S/4HANA QM – Quality Notification; IATF 16949 Section 8.6; SPC AIAG Reference Manual

description: Indicates whether this downtime event is a recurrence of a previously recorded failure on the same equipment or work center within a defined lookback period (typically 30 days). True = repeat failure; False = first occurrence. Used to identify chronic equipment issues requiring escalated corrective action under IATF 16949 Section 10.2.
reference: IATF 16949 Section 10.2 – Nonconformity and Corrective Action; SAP PM – Recurring Breakdown

description: Indicates whether the downtime event involved a safety incident, near-miss, or safety-critical equipment failure (e.g., AGV collision, robot safety stop, lockout/tagout activation). True = safety-related; False = non-safety. Triggers mandatory safety reporting and OSHA/DOT compliance escalation workflows.
reference: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 – Machine Safety; DOT FMVSS; IATF 16949 Section 8.4.2

description: The timestamp when the downtime event record was most recently modified in the source system, such as when resolution notes were added, status was updated, or cost data was posted. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail in the Silver layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
reference: IATF 16949 Section 7.5 – Documented Information; Databricks Lakehouse – Delta Lake Change Data Capture

description: Total direct maintenance cost incurred to resolve the downtime event, including labor, spare parts, and external service costs, expressed in the plant's local currency. Sourced from SAP PM actual cost settlement. Used for cost-of-downtime analysis and CapEx vs. OpEx maintenance budget reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM – Actual Cost; SAP CO – Cost Center Accounting; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

description: The vehicle model year (MY) of the production program running on the affected line at the time of the downtime event. Used to correlate downtime patterns with specific model year launches, SOP (Start of Production) ramp-up periods, and EOP (End of Production) transitions.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Program; NHTSA MY Definition; Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Model Year

description: The SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) notification number (Meldungsnummer) created in SAP S/4HANA to formally record the maintenance request or breakdown notification associated with this downtime event. Enables traceability between the MES downtime record and the SAP PM work order lifecycle.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM – PM Notification (IW21/IW22); IATF 16949 Section 7.1.3

description: The percentage of scheduled production time lost due to this downtime event, calculated as (duration_minutes / scheduled_production_time_minutes) × 100. Represents the availability loss component of the OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) metric for the affected work center during the event period. Stored as a business field for direct use in OEE dashboards.
reference: ISO 22400-2 – OEE Availability; IATF 16949 Section 9.1; SEMI E10 Standard

description: The powertrain type of the vehicle being produced at the time of the downtime event. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine, HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle, PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle, EV = Electric Vehicle, FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Used to analyze downtime patterns by powertrain technology, particularly relevant for EV/PHEV line ramp-up monitoring.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP – Material Classification; CAFE/EPA Powertrain Classification; UNECE Regulation

description: Number of vehicle units or production units lost due to the downtime event, based on the planned production rate for the affected work center. Used to quantify the production order impact and schedule recovery requirements.
reference: ISO 22400-2 – Production Loss; SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Order Confirmation; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

description: Free-text field capturing the maintenance technician's description of the actions taken to resolve the downtime event and restore production. Complements corrective_action_code with detailed narrative. Stored in the Silver layer for use in AI/ML-based predictive maintenance model training.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM – Work Order Completion Text; IATF 16949 Section 10.2; AIAG 8D Step 5

description: Standardized code identifying the confirmed root cause of the downtime event after investigation, aligned with the SAP PM cause code catalog. Distinct from failure_mode_code which captures the symptom; root_cause_code captures the underlying reason (e.g., inadequate lubrication, worn tooling, incorrect setup, supplier part defect).
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM – Cause Code; IATF 16949 Section 10.2; AIAG 8D Problem Solving

description: The alarm or fault code generated by the SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) or PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) system at the time the downtime event was triggered. Provides the raw machine-level signal that initiated the downtime record. Used for SCADA-integrated downtime reporting and automated event correlation.
reference: IEC 62682 – Management of Alarm Systems; SCADA/PLC Event Log; Apriso MES – Machine Signal Integration

description: The production shift during which the downtime event occurred (e.g., shift_1 = day shift, shift_2 = afternoon shift, shift_3 = night shift, weekend = weekend shift). Used for shift-level OEE analysis and workforce accountability reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift Planning; Apriso MES – Shift Definition; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

description: Indicates whether spare parts or materials were consumed from inventory to resolve the downtime event. True = spare parts were issued via SAP MM goods issue; False = no parts consumed (e.g., adjustment or reset only). Drives spare parts demand planning and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) replenishment.
reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – Goods Issue; SAP PM – Material Consumption; MRP APICS Standard

description: The exact date and time when the downtime event began, as recorded by the MES or SCADA system. This is the principal real-world event time used for duration calculation and shift-level reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – Downtime Start; SCADA Event Log; ISO 22400-2

description: Elapsed time in minutes from when the maintenance team began active repair work to when the equipment was restored to operational status. Distinct from duration_minutes (total downtime) and time_to_respond_minutes (response lag). Core component of MTTR (Mean Time to Repair) KPI calculation.
reference: ISO 22400-2 – MTTR; SAP PM – Repair Duration; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

description: Elapsed time in minutes between the downtime event start_timestamp and the time the responsible maintenance or production team acknowledged and began responding to the event. Key metric for maintenance response SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance and MTTR (Mean Time to Repair) component analysis.
reference: IATF 16949 Section 9.1; SAP PM – Response Time; ISO 22400-2 – MTTR

description: The internal vehicle model or platform code (e.g., F-150, Silverado, Model 3 equivalent) being produced on the affected line at the time of the downtime event. Enables model-specific downtime analysis and supports PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) integration.
reference: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Vehicle Program Code; SAP S/4HANA PP – Material Master

description: The SAP PM maintenance work order number (Auftragsnummer) issued to address the downtime event. Distinct from the production order; this is the corrective or preventive maintenance order raised by the maintenance team in SAP PM.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM – Maintenance Order (IW31/IW32); IATF 16949 Section 8.5

reference: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; SAP S/4HANA PM — Tool Management

reference: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — Production Order

reference: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG APQP Manual — Control Plan

description: Revision level of the control plan in effect at the time of this parameter reading. Ensures traceability to the correct engineering specification version.
reference: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG APQP Manual; Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Engineering Change

description: Calculated difference between the measured value and the nominal (target) value (measured_value minus nominal_value). Positive values indicate above-nominal readings; negative values indicate below-nominal. Stored as a raw field to support SPC trend analysis without requiring a join.
reference: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1

description: Date by which the measurement instrument or gauge used for this reading is due for recalibration. Readings taken after the calibration due date may be flagged as suspect for quality audit purposes.
reference: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 7.1.5.1 — Measurement System Analysis; ISO 10012 — Measurement Management Systems

description: Indicates whether this reading triggered an SPC out-of-control signal based on Western Electric or Nelson rules applied to the control chart. True = out-of-control signal detected; False = in statistical control. Distinct from pass_fail_status which checks specification limits.
reference: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; ISO 7870-2 — Control Charts; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1

description: Statistical Lower Control Limit (LCL) for this process parameter as defined by SPC methodology. Readings below this value indicate the process is out of statistical control.
reference: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; ISO 7870-2 — Control Charts

description: Engineering Lower Specification Limit (LSL) for this process parameter as defined in the control plan or engineering drawing. Readings below LSL result in a non-conformance. Distinct from LCL which is a statistical control boundary.
reference: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG APQP Manual; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6

description: The actual numeric value of the process parameter as measured by the PLC/SCADA sensor at the time of the reading (e.g., 8500.0 amperes for weld current, 25.5 Nm for torque, 120.0 µm for paint film thickness).
reference: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5

description: Identifier of the measurement system (gauge, sensor, or instrument) used to capture this reading. Supports Measurement System Analysis (MSA) / Gauge R&R traceability per AIAG MSA manual.
reference: AIAG MSA Manual 4th Edition — Measurement System Analysis; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 7.1.5

description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the Apriso/Dassault MES system when this process parameter reading was recorded. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the MES operational system.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution and Traceability

description: Model Year (MY) of the vehicle being built when this process parameter was captured (e.g., 2025). Supports model-year-level SPC trending and quality reporting.
reference: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Order

description: The engineering-specified nominal or target value for this process parameter as defined in the control plan. Used as the centre line for SPC charting and deviation calculation.
reference: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG APQP Manual; AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition

description: Reference number of the Non-Conformance Report (NCR) raised in the quality management system (SAP QM) when this parameter reading resulted in a fail disposition. Null when pass_fail_status is 'pass'.
reference: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.7 — Control of Nonconforming Outputs; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the specific process parameter definition (e.g., WELD_CURR_01, TORQUE_BOLT_A, PAINT_FILM_T). Sourced from the PLC/SCADA parameter catalogue in Apriso MES.

reference: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition

description: Result of the automated conformance check comparing the measured value against the specification limits. 'pass' = within LSL/USL; 'fail' = outside LSL/USL; 'warning' = within spec but outside UCL/LCL (statistically out of control); 'rework_required' = fail with rework disposition; 'inconclusive' = sensor error or missing reference limits.
reference: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6

description: Unique tag identifier from the Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) or SCADA system that is the source of this parameter reading. Enables traceability back to the originating control system data point.

description: Powertrain type of the vehicle being built: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), or FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). description: Exact date and time when the process parameter value was measured by the PLC/SCADA system. This is the principal business event timestamp for this record, representing the real-world moment of measurement.

reference: ISO 8601 — Date and Time Formats; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information

description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this process parameter record in the data platform. Used for incremental load tracking and audit trail purposes.
reference: ISO 8601 — Date and Time Formats; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information

description: Sequential sample number within the SPC subgroup or sampling plan for this parameter at this work center. Used to construct X-bar/R charts and other SPC control charts.
reference: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1

business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) System ID
description: Identifier of the SCADA system instance that collected and transmitted this process parameter reading to the MES/data platform.
reference: IEC 62443 — Industrial Automation and Control Systems Security; Apriso/Dassault MES Integration

description: Code identifying the production shift during which this parameter reading was captured (e.g., 'SHIFT_A', 'SHIFT_B', 'SHIFT_C'). Supports shift-level SPC analysis and quality reporting.
reference: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; SAP S/4HANA PP — Shift Planning

description: Identifies the specific SPC detection rule that was violated when is_out_of_control is True (e.g., 'RULE_1_BEYOND_3SIGMA', 'RULE_2_NINE_CONSECUTIVE', 'RULE_3_SIX_TRENDING'). Null when no rule is violated.
reference: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition — Western Electric Rules; ISO 7870-2

description: Identifier of the SPC rational subgroup to which this reading belongs. Subgroups are used to calculate control limits and assess process variation in X-bar/R or X-bar/S charts.
reference: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition — Rational Subgrouping; ISO 7870-2

description: Engineering unit of measure for the measured value (e.g., 'A' for amperes, 'Nm' for Newton-metres, 'µm' for micrometres, '°C' for Celsius, 'kN' for kilonewtons, 'mm' for millimetres, 'ms' for milliseconds). Follows SI unit conventions.
reference: ISO 80000-1 — Quantities and Units; AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition

description: Statistical Upper Control Limit (UCL) for this process parameter as defined by SPC methodology. Readings above this value indicate the process is out of statistical control.
reference: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; ISO 7870-2 — Control Charts

description: Engineering Upper Specification Limit (USL) for this process parameter as defined in the control plan or engineering drawing. Readings above USL result in a non-conformance. Distinct from UCL which is a statistical control boundary.
reference: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG APQP Manual; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6

description: Internal vehicle model or platform code for the vehicle being built (e.g., 'F150', 'RAV4', 'MODEL_3'). Supports model-level process capability analysis and SPC stratification.
reference: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; SAP S/4HANA PP — Material Master

description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) of the vehicle being processed at the time of this parameter reading. Enables full build traceability from process parameter to finished vehicle per NHTSA requirements.
reference: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 — VIN Requirements; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.2

description: Unique surrogate identifier for the production confirmation record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity. Entity Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete business event (completion of a production order or partial operation) with a clear lifecycle.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — CO11N/CO15 Confirmation Object

description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this production confirmation was posted. Enables plant-level production output reporting, capacity utilization analysis, and multi-plant benchmarking.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Plant (WERKS); ISO 14001 Facility Identification

description: Reference to the production operator (employee/personnel number) who posted or was responsible for this confirmation. Used for traceability, quality accountability, and workforce productivity analysis. Maps to SAP HR personnel number (PERNR) or MES operator badge ID.

description: Reference to the production operator (employee/personnel number) who posted or was responsible for this confirmation. Used for traceability, quality accountability, and workforce productivity analysis. Maps to SAP HR personnel number (PERNR) or MES operator badge ID.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Personnel Number (PERNR); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 Traceability; SuccessFactors Employee Record

description: Reference to the original production confirmation record that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Enables audit trail reconstruction and net quantity calculation when reversals are present. Self-referencing within the production_confirmation product.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — CO13 Reversal Reference; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 Traceability

description: Reference to the production shift during which this confirmation was recorded. Enables shift-level production output analysis, yield comparison across shifts, and workforce productivity reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Shift (SCHICHT); Apriso MES Shift Management

description: Reference to the work center (SAP ARBPL) where the confirmed operation was executed. Used for capacity reporting and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) analysis.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Work Center (ARBPL); IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3 Infrastructure

description: SAP CO activity type (LSTAR) used to record the confirmed actual activities (setup, machine, labor) against the production order. Drives cost settlement rates and actual cost calculation in SAP CO-PC (Product Costing). Required for standard vs. actual cost variance analysis.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC — Activity Type (LSTAR); IATF 16949 Clause 9.1.3

description: The manufacturing assembly stage at which this confirmation was recorded. Reflects the major production process area within the vehicle manufacturing flow. reference: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Stage; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 Production Control Plan

description: The unit of measure in which yield, scrap, and rework quantities are expressed. description: Method by which this production confirmation was entered into SAP PP. Used for data quality auditing and process automation tracking.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Confirmation Entry Mode; Apriso MES Integration; SCADA Interface

reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — CO11N Confirmation Number (RUECK); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 Traceability

description: Current lifecycle status of the production confirmation record. 'created' = confirmation entered but not yet posted; 'posted' = successfully posted to SAP PP and inventory updated; 'reversed' = confirmation reversed via CO13; 'cancelled' = voided before posting; 'partial' = partial quantity confirmed, order still open; 'final' = final confirmation closing the production order.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Confirmation Status (CO11N/CO13); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: The principal real-world event timestamp recording when the production operation or order was confirmed as complete on the shop floor. This is the business event time (not the system posting time) and represents the actual completion moment. Maps to SAP PP fields BUDAT (posting date) + ISDD/ISDZ (actual execution date/time). Used for takt time analysis, shift output reporting, and production scheduling.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — CO11N Actual Execution Timestamp (ISDD/ISDZ); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

description: Classification of the confirmation indicating whether it is a partial confirmation (interim progress), final confirmation (order completion), automatic system-generated confirmation, milestone-based confirmation, or a reversal entry. Determines downstream SAP PP processing logic including order closure and goods receipt.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Confirmation Category (STOKZ); Apriso MES Confirmation Type

description: SAP CO cost center (KOSTL) associated with the work center where this confirmation was posted. Used for actual cost allocation, activity-based costing, and manufacturing cost variance reporting. Enables EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization) analysis at the plant and cost center level.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO — Cost Center (KOSTL); IATF 16949 Clause 9.1.3 Management Review

description: The timestamp when this production confirmation record was first created in the source system (SAP PP or MES). Represents the system audit creation time, distinct from the confirmation_timestamp (business event time). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SLA monitoring of confirmation posting latency.
reference: SAP S/4HANA — Record Creation Timestamp; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 Documented Information

description: Total unplanned downtime duration recorded during this production confirmation period, in minutes. Captured from SCADA/PLC systems or MES downtime tracking. Used for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) availability calculation, maintenance planning, and production loss analysis.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES — Downtime Tracking; SCADA Integration; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3

description: Coded reason for any downtime recorded during this confirmation period. Maps to the plant's downtime reason catalog (e.g., 'MECH' = Mechanical Failure, 'MATL' = Material Shortage, 'QUAL' = Quality Hold, 'CHNG' = Changeover). Used for root cause analysis, maintenance prioritization, and production loss reporting.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES — Downtime Reason Catalog; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3; SAP PM Integration

description: Indicates whether this confirmation is the final confirmation for the production order (SAP PP IEDD — Final Confirmation Indicator). When True, SAP PP automatically closes the production order, triggers goods receipt for the finished product, and initiates order settlement to CO (Controlling). Critical for order lifecycle management and inventory accuracy.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Final Confirmation Indicator (IEDD); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: Indicates whether the automatic goods receipt (GR) to inventory has been successfully posted as a result of this production confirmation. True = inventory has been updated with the confirmed yield quantity. Used for inventory reconciliation and to identify confirmations where GR posting failed or is pending.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM — Goods Receipt (MIGO/MB31); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: Actual direct labor time consumed for this production operation, recorded in minutes. Maps to SAP PP activity type for labor (ISRLA — Actual Labor Time). Used for labor cost settlement to the production order, workforce productivity analysis, and standard vs. actual cost variance reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO — Actual Labor Time (ISRLA); IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.2 People

description: Planned direct labor time for this operation as defined in the SAP PP routing, recorded in minutes. Baseline for labor efficiency variance analysis and standard cost calculation.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO — Routing Planned Labor Time; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: The timestamp when this production confirmation record was last modified in the source system. Tracks reversals, corrections, and status updates. Used for incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and change data capture (CDC) processing.
reference: SAP S/4HANA — Record Change Timestamp; Databricks Delta Lake CDC; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5

description: Actual machine runtime consumed for this production operation, recorded in minutes. Maps to SAP PP activity type for machine time (ISRÜT — Actual Machine Time). Core input for OEE calculation, takt time variance analysis, and capacity utilization reporting. Compared against planned machine time from the routing to identify bottlenecks.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Actual Machine Time (ISRÜT); IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3; OEE Standard

description: Planned machine time for this operation as defined in the SAP PP routing, recorded in minutes. Baseline for actual vs. planned machine time variance analysis and takt time adherence reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Routing Planned Machine Time; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: SAP material number (MATNR) of the finished or semi-finished product being confirmed. Identifies the vehicle model, sub-assembly, or component produced in this confirmation. Essential for inventory goods receipt posting and BOM (Bill of Materials) reconciliation.
reference: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP — Material Master (MATNR); ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.1

description: The confirmation or transaction reference number from the Apriso/Dassault MES system that corresponds to this SAP PP production confirmation. reference: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution Traceability; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

description: The vehicle model year (MY) of the product being confirmed. Used for production output reporting by model year, regulatory compliance tracking (CAFE, EPA emissions), and alignment with SOP (Start of Production) and EOP (End of Production) milestones. Retained as a denormalized attribute for direct reporting without joining to vehicle configuration.
reference: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 — Model Year; CAFE Standards; EPA Emissions Reporting

description: Routing operation number (VORNR) within the production order being confirmed. Identifies the specific manufacturing step (e.g., 0010 = Stamping, 0020 = Body Weld, 0030 = Paint, 0040 = Final Assembly) for partial confirmation scenarios. Maps to SAP PP routing operation.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Routing Operation (VORNR); Apriso/Dassault MES Operation Sequence

description: Status of the SAP CO production order settlement triggered by this final confirmation. 'pending' = settlement not yet executed; 'settled' = actual costs fully settled to cost objects; 'partially_settled' = partial settlement completed; 'not_required' = non-final confirmation, settlement not applicable. Used for period-end closing and financial reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC — Order Settlement (KO88); IATF 16949 Clause 9.1.3

description: The accounting/inventory posting date (SAP BUDAT) on which the production confirmation is financially posted. May differ from the confirmation timestamp when confirmations are entered retroactively. Drives inventory valuation, cost object settlement, and financial period assignment.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO — Posting Date (BUDAT); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: The powertrain technology type of the vehicle or assembly being confirmed. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine, HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle, PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle, BEV = Battery Electric Vehicle, FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Used for regulatory reporting (CAFE, EPA, CARB), EV production mix analysis, and R&D investment tracking.
reference: EPA Clean Air Act — Powertrain Classification; CARB ZEV Mandate; CAFE Standards; UNECE Regulations

description: SAP PP production order number (AUFNR) to which this confirmation is posted. Retained as a business attribute for direct shop floor reporting without requiring a join.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Order (AUFNR); ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.1

description: SAP QM inspection lot number (PRUEFLOS) created automatically upon goods receipt posting from this confirmation. reference: SAP S/4HANA QM — Inspection Lot (PRUEFLOS); IATF 16949 Clause 8.6 Release of Products

description: Flag indicating whether this confirmation record is a reversal entry (CO13 reversal in SAP PP). True = this record reverses a previously posted confirmation. reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — CO13 Confirmation Reversal (STOKZ); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: The quantity of units requiring rework (reprocessing to meet specification) identified during this confirmation. Distinct from scrap (which is permanently rejected). description: The quantity of units scrapped (rejected as non-conforming) during this production operation. Maps to SAP PP field XMNGA (Scrap Quantity). Used for PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate calculation, scrap cost reporting, and FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) input. Triggers quality notification creation when thresholds are exceeded.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP/QM — Scrap Quantity (XMNGA); IATF 16949 Clause 8.7 Nonconforming Outputs; SPC

description: Coded reason for scrap recorded against this confirmation. Maps to SAP QM defect codes or MES scrap reason catalog (e.g., 'DIM' = Dimensional Non-conformance, 'WLD' = Weld Defect, 'PNT' = Paint Defect, 'ASY' = Assembly Error). Required for PPM (Parts Per Million) defect analysis, FMEA updates, and quality improvement initiatives per IATF 16949.
reference: SAP S/4HANA QM — Defect Code (FEHLERNR); IATF 16949 Clause 8.7.1; APQP Control Plan

description: Actual machine/workstation setup time consumed for this operation, recorded in minutes. Maps to SAP PP activity type for setup (ISRST — Actual Setup Time). Used for capacity planning, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation, and comparison against planned setup time from the routing.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Actual Setup Time (ISRST); SAE J4000 Lean Manufacturing Assessment

description: Planned setup time for this operation as defined in the SAP PP routing, recorded in minutes. Provides the baseline for actual vs. planned setup time variance analysis. Sourced from the routing master data at the time of production order creation.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Routing Planned Setup Time; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: SAP storage location (LGORT) to which the confirmed yield quantity is posted as a goods receipt. Required for inventory management and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) delivery coordination.
reference: SAP S/4HANA MM/WM — Storage Location (LGORT); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.4 Preservation

reference: SAE J4000 Lean Manufacturing; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1; Apriso MES Takt Time Monitoring

description: Actual teardown/cleanup time consumed after the production operation, recorded in minutes. Maps to SAP PP activity type for teardown. Included in total operation time for accurate takt time and capacity utilization calculations. Relevant for paint booth cleaning, tooling changeover, and AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) repositioning cycles.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Actual Teardown Time; SAE J4000

description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number assigned to the vehicle unit confirmed in this production record. description: The confirmed good quantity (yield) produced in this confirmation, expressed in the base unit of measure of the material. The total actual cost incurred to execute this production order, including material consumption, labor, machine, and overhead costs as settled in SAP CO. Expressed in the plant's local currency. Used for cost variance analysis, profitability reporting, and CapEx/OpEx tracking.

description: The total actual machine/equipment hours consumed during execution of this production order, as recorded by SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems or MES. Used for OEE analysis, machine utilization reporting, and cost variance calculation.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; SCADA; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

description: The precise date and time when production activities for this order actually commenced on the shop floor, as recorded by the MES or confirmed by the first operation confirmation in SAP PP. Used for cycle time analysis and schedule adherence measurement.

description: The date and time when this production order record was first created in the source system (SAP PP). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle management. Maps to SAP order creation timestamp (ERDAT + ERZET).

Indicates whether this production order involves the use or production of hazardous materials (e.g., battery electrolytes for EV/HEV powertrains, paint solvents, chemical treatments). The date and time when this production order record was most recently modified in the source system. Used for change tracking, delta load processing in the lakehouse pipeline, and audit compliance under IATF 16949.

description: SAP PP routing operation number (Vorgangs-Nr.) identifying the specific manufacturing step being performed on this WIP item. Aligns with the production order routing sequence.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP – Routing Operations; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: Date and time when the manufacturing operation on this WIP item was started by the operator or automated system. Represents the principal business event time for this WIP transaction.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – Shop Floor Execution; SAP S/4HANA PP – Confirmation

description: Powertrain technology type of the vehicle being assembled: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), EV (Electric Vehicle), or FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Drives assembly process routing and regulatory reporting.
reference: EPA Emissions Standards; CARB ZEV Mandate; SAE J1711

description: Production priority assigned to this WIP item. 'EXPEDITE' indicates a rush order requiring immediate processing to meet customer or dealer commitment. Used by shop floor supervisors to manage queue sequencing.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Order Priority; Apriso/Dassault MES

description: Quantity of units represented by this WIP inventory record. Typically 1 for discrete vehicle assemblies; may be greater than 1 for batch sub-assembly components (e.g., fasteners, brackets).
reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – Stock Quantity; IATF 16949

description: Date and time when this WIP inventory record was first created in the source MES system. Audit trail field for data lineage and IATF 16949 traceability compliance.
Date and time when this WIP inventory record was last modified in the source MES system. Used for change detection and incremental Silver Layer ingestion.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

description: SAP PP production order number (Auftragsnummer) from SAP S/4HANA that corresponds to the production_order_id. Retained as a business-visible identifier for cross-system reconciliation between MES and ERP.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Order; IATF 16949

description: Planned date by which this WIP item is expected to complete the current operation or exit the current stage, as defined in the production order schedule. Used for OTD (On-Time Delivery) tracking.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Order Scheduling; OTD KPI

description: Code identifying the reason a WIP item was scrapped (e.g., dimensional non-conformance, weld failure, paint defect, crash damage). Populated only when wip_status = 'scrapped'. Feeds PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dimensional_nonconformance|weld_failure|paint_defect|crash_damage|material_defect|process_error — promote to reference product]
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; SAP S/4HANA QM – Scrap; PPM Reporting

description: Just-in-Sequence (JIS) position number assigned to this WIP item within the production line sequence. Critical for sequenced delivery of components (e.g., seats, instrument panels) and for maintaining build order integrity.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – JIS Sequencing; SAE J4000 – JIS Principles

description: Date and time when this WIP inventory snapshot record was captured. Supports point-in-time WIP visibility and Silver Layer delta processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – WIP Snapshot; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

description: Planned standard cycle time in seconds for the current operation on this WIP item, as defined in the SAP PP routing. Used to calculate actual vs. standard cycle time variance and identify takt time deviations.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP – Routing Standard Values; SAE J4000 – Lean Manufacturing

description: Unique identifier for a sub-assembly unit (e.g., powertrain module, instrument panel, axle assembly) when the WIP item is not yet associated with a full VIN. Assigned by the MES during component-level traceability.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – Component Traceability; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

description: Reference number for an approved supplier deviation or concession allowing a non-standard component to be used in this WIP item. Issued via PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) deviation process.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7.1 – Supplier Deviation; PPAP Requirements

description: Unit of measure for the WIP quantity (e.g., EA = each for discrete assemblies, KG for weight-based materials). Aligns with SAP base unit of measure (Basismengeneinheit). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|M|M2|M3|PC|SET — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – Unit of Measure; ISO 80000

description: Internal code identifying the vehicle model or nameplate being assembled (e.g., F-150, Silverado, Model 3 equivalent). Supports model-mix analysis and JIS sequencing.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP – Material Master; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number assigned to the vehicle body or chassis associated with this WIP item. Populated once the VIN is stamped during body shop operations; null for sub-assembly WIP prior to VIN assignment.
reference: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 – VIN Requirements; ISO 3779

description: Human-readable, externally visible business identifier for this WIP inventory record, generated by the MES (Manufacturing Execution System). Used on shop floor traveler documents and in MES dashboards.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – Shop Floor Traceability; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

description: Current lifecycle status of the WIP item on the shop floor. 'in_process' = actively being worked on; 'on_hold' = paused pending resolution; 'awaiting_inspection' = queued for quality gate; 'scrapped' = condemned and removed from flow; 'completed' = operation finished; 'rework' = returned for corrective operations.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – WIP Status; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7 – Nonconforming Outputs

description: Standard cost valuation of this WIP item in the plant currency, calculated based on the accumulated material and activity costs up to the current production stage. Used for WIP inventory valuation in SAP CO (Controlling) and financial reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO – WIP Valuation; IAS 2 – Inventories; GAAP

Unique surrogate identifier for each capacity plan record in the manufacturing domain. Primary key for the capacity_plan data product.

Reference to the work center identified as the capacity bottleneck constraining overall line throughput during this planning period. Used to prioritize capacity improvement investments and focus S&OP constraint management.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Bottleneck Work Center (CM21); Theory of Constraints; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Reference to the manufacturing or industrial engineering employee responsible for maintaining and updating this capacity plan. Supports accountability tracking in S&OP governance.
Reference to the manufacturing plant for which this capacity plan is defined. Links to the manufacturing.plant master record.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Work Center / Plant; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3

description: Reference to the manufacturing or industrial engineering employee responsible for maintaining and updating this capacity plan. Supports accountability tracking in S&OP governance.

Reference to the specific production line (e.g., final assembly line, body shop line, paint line) within the plant for which capacity is being planned. Links to the manufacturing.work_center or production line master.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Line; Apriso/Dassault MES — Line Configuration

description: Reference to the shift pattern (e.g., 1-shift, 2-shift, 3-shift) applied in this capacity plan. Shift pattern determines available production hours and directly impacts rated capacity calculation.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Shift Definition; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Foreign key linking to engineering.vehicle_program. Business justification: Capacity planning aligns plant capacity with each vehicle program; capacity_plan needs vehicle_program reference.
Date and time when the capacity plan was formally approved by the designated authority. Marks the transition from 'submitted' to 'approved' status in the S&OP governance process.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 5.3; SAP S/4HANA PP — Approval Workflow

description: Name or employee identifier of the S&OP or manufacturing leadership authority who approved this capacity plan. Required for audit trail and governance compliance under IATF 16949.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 5.3 — Organizational Roles; SAP S/4HANA PP — Approval Workflow

description: Total scheduled production hours available in the planning period after accounting for planned downtime, shift breaks, and scheduled maintenance. Used in conjunction with rated_capacity_jph to compute rated capacity in units.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Available Capacity; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Narrative description of the primary capacity constraint at the bottleneck work center (e.g., 'Paint oven cycle time limits throughput to 58 JPH', 'Robotic welding cell maintenance window reduces available hours'). Supports root cause analysis and CapEx justification.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning Notes; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Difference between planned_production_units and demonstrated_capacity_units, representing the capacity shortfall or surplus for the planning period. Positive value indicates a capacity gap requiring corrective action (overtime, additional shifts, CapEx); negative value indicates surplus capacity.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Leveling; S&OP Process; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Classification of the capacity planning methodology used. 'rough_cut' (RCCP — Rough Cut Capacity Planning) for high-level S&OP; 'detailed' for work-center-level CRP (Capacity Requirements Planning); 'constraint_based' for Theory of Constraints analysis; 'what_if' for scenario planning and CapEx evaluation.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — RCCP/CRP; APICS CPIM Body of Knowledge

description: Planned capacity utilization rate expressed as a percentage, calculated as (planned_production_units / rated_capacity_units) × 100. Drives S&OP decisions on overtime, additional shifts, and capital investment. Target thresholds are typically 85–95% for automotive assembly.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Utilization; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1; S&OP Best Practice

description: Estimated capital expenditure amount required to address the capacity gap identified in this plan. Expressed in the plant's operating currency. Used for CapEx budget submissions and investment approval processes.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Investment Management; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Indicates whether this capacity plan identifies a requirement for capital investment (CapEx) to close a capacity gap (e.g., new tooling, additional robots, facility expansion). Triggers CapEx approval workflow in SAP FI/CO.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — CapEx Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Hours allocated for model changeovers, tooling changes, and line reconfigurations during the planning period. Relevant for mixed-model assembly lines producing multiple vehicle variants (e.g., ICE and BEV on the same line).
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Setup Time; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: Date and time when this capacity plan record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for data lineage and compliance purposes.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in this capacity plan record (e.g., USD, EUR, MXN, CNY). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-plant, multi-currency manufacturing operations.
reference: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Configuration

description: Planned number of vehicles to be produced per working day during the planning period, derived from planned_production_units / working_days. Used for daily MES scheduling and shift-level production targets.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Daily Production Target; Apriso/Dassault MES

description: Actual production output achieved in a comparable prior period, used as the realistic baseline for capacity planning. Reflects real-world constraints such as quality losses, minor stoppages, and changeovers. Key input to APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) capacity studies.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 8.4.1 — PPAP Capacity Study; APQP Reference Manual

description: Planned End of Production (EOP) date for the vehicle model or program covered by this capacity plan. Marks the milestone when production of the model is scheduled to cease. Used for capacity wind-down planning and asset redeployment decisions.
reference: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Program Milestones; APQP Reference Manual; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

description: Fiscal year (FY) to which this capacity plan belongs, used for CapEx (Capital Expenditure) alignment, budget planning, and financial reporting. Format: FY followed by 4-digit year (e.g., FY2025).
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Fiscal Year; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Total direct labor headcount required to execute the planned production volume during the planning period. Used for workforce planning, hiring decisions, and labor cost budgeting in SuccessFactors and SAP CO.
reference: SuccessFactors — Workforce Planning; SAP S/4HANA CO — Labor Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.2

description: Indicates whether the capacity plan is constrained by a bottleneck work center that limits overall line throughput below the planned production target. When True, the bottleneck_work_center_id and bottleneck_constraint_description fields are populated.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Bottleneck Scheduling; Theory of Constraints; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Automotive model year (MY) for which this capacity plan is prepared. Capacity plans are typically aligned to MY production programs, SOP (Start of Production), and EOP (End of Production) milestones.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program; NHTSA MY Designation

description: Number of production shifts planned per working day for this capacity plan (e.g., 1, 2, or 3 shifts). Directly determines available production hours and total capacity for the planning period.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Shift Model; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Last calendar date of the planning period covered by this capacity plan record. Together with plan_start_date, defines the planning window for capacity supply and demand balancing.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; ISO 8601 Date Standard

description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the capacity plan record, used in S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) communications, SAP PP capacity planning transactions (CM01/CM21), and cross-functional reporting. Format: CP-{PLANT}-{YEAR}-{MONTH}-{SEQ}.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning (CM01); IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: First calendar date of the planning period covered by this capacity plan record. Used to align capacity supply with demand signals from S&OP and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) runs.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; ISO 8601 Date Standard

description: Current lifecycle state of the capacity plan record. 'draft' indicates work-in-progress; 'submitted' indicates pending approval; 'approved' indicates sign-off by S&OP leadership; 'active' indicates the operative plan driving production scheduling; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version; 'archived' indicates historical record.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 6.1; SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning

description: Version identifier of the capacity plan, enabling management of multiple planning iterations (e.g., v1.0, v2.0) within the same planning period. Supports S&OP cycle versioning and plan-over-plan variance analysis.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Total planned downtime hours for the production line during the planning period, including scheduled maintenance, tooling changeovers, model changeovers, and planned shutdowns. Reduces available production hours from the theoretical maximum.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM — Maintenance Planning; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: Subset of planned downtime hours specifically allocated to preventive and predictive maintenance activities on production equipment. Tracked separately from changeover downtime for maintenance KPI reporting and SAP PM integration.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM — Preventive Maintenance; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: Total overtime hours planned for the production line during the planning period to meet production targets beyond standard shift capacity. Feeds into workforce cost planning and labor budget in SAP CO.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO — Capacity Planning; SuccessFactors Workforce Planning

description: Number of vehicles planned for production in the planning period as agreed in the S&OP process. Represents the demand signal that capacity must satisfy. Compared against rated and demonstrated capacity to identify gaps.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program; S&OP Process

description: Granularity of the capacity planning horizon for this record. 'weekly' supports short-term MES scheduling; 'monthly' supports S&OP cycles; 'quarterly' and 'annual' support CapEx and strategic workforce planning.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning Horizon; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Demand scenario underpinning this capacity plan. 'base' reflects the consensus S&OP forecast; 'optimistic' reflects upside demand; 'pessimistic' reflects downside risk; 'stretch' reflects maximum achievable output. Enables scenario comparison for executive decision-making.
reference: S&OP Best Practice; SAP S/4HANA PP — Planning Scenario

description: Powertrain technology type planned for production in this capacity plan. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine; HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle; PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle; BEV = Battery Electric Vehicle; FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Impacts tooling, line configuration, and capacity requirements.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program; EPA Emissions Standards; CAFE Regulations

description: Theoretical maximum production rate expressed in Jobs Per Hour (JPH) for the production line under ideal conditions. Derived from takt time and line design specifications. Used as the baseline for capacity utilization calculations in S&OP.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Definition; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1; SAE J3061

description: Theoretical maximum number of vehicles that can be produced in the planning period, calculated as rated_capacity_jph × available_hours. Represents the upper bound of production capacity for S&OP and CapEx planning.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning (CM01); IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Source system identifier for this capacity plan record in SAP S/4HANA PP (Production Planning) module, used for data lineage traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational ERP system.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning (CM01/CM21); Data Lineage Best Practice

description: Planned Start of Production (SOP) date for the vehicle model or program covered by this capacity plan. Marks the milestone when full-rate production is scheduled to begin. Critical for capacity ramp-up planning and APQP milestone tracking.
reference: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Program Milestones; APQP Reference Manual; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

description: Planned takt time in seconds for the production line during this planning period, representing the rate at which vehicles must be produced to meet customer demand. Takt time = available production time / planned production units. Core metric in JIS (Just-in-Sequence) and line balancing.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Work Center Takt Time; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Date and time when this capacity plan record was last modified. Tracks plan revisions through the S&OP cycle and supports change management auditing.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

description: Internal OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) code identifying the vehicle model or program (e.g., platform code, nameplate code) for which this capacity plan is prepared. Enables capacity planning at the model/program level.
reference: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Product Structure; SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program

description: Number of scheduled working days in the planning period after excluding weekends, public holidays, and planned plant shutdowns. Used to compute daily production targets and available hours.
